state.on: Community insights are on for {{name}} since {{date}} (turned on by {{who}}).
state.renewalNeeded: The text changed since it was turned on, so it is off for {{name}} until you agree again.

screen.intro: You can let some of {{name}}'s records be used, together with those of many other babies, to calculate statistics by age: how much milk babies this age usually drink, how growth compares, tummy time, sleep and feeding routines, what helps most with crying.
screen.onlyUse: We only use age in weeks, amounts, lengths, counts and measurements. Never names, date of birth, notes, photos, location or exact times.
screen.groups: We only publish numbers for groups of at least 20 babies from different families. None of {{name}}'s records leave your account, and nothing is sold or used for advertising.
screen.optional: It is optional. Without it, the app works the same. You can turn it off at any time: {{name}}'s records stop being used from the next calculation. Group numbers already calculated cannot be separated out, and are replaced.
screen.guardian: I am {{name}}'s parent or legal guardian.
screen.agree: I agree that {{name}}'s records are used for these statistics, as described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.outdated: This text changed. Reload the app and read the current one.
errors.notAllowed: Only owners and parents can change this.
